purpose: Establish monitoring protocol for recompute surface completion and next-step decision rule

monitoring_targets.completion_signal: status changes from PENDING_RECOMPUTE to COMPLETED or trigger shows computed_state
monitoring_targets.materiality_indicator: qm_coherence_metric values show measurable change vs. pre-promotion baseline

monitoring_targets.completion_signal: status changes or computed transport outputs appear
monitoring_targets.materiality_indicator: ledger transport state/flux patterns differ from prior state

monitoring_targets.completion_signal: triggers show completed status or computed transport results
monitoring_targets.materiality_indicator: blocker-to-authority propagation patterns or timing changed

continuation_decision_rule.trigger_event: ANY recompute surface leaves PENDING_RECOMPUTE state OR any surface shows computed_state/outputs
continuation_decision_rule.continuation_action: Rerun POST_RECOMPUTE_OBSERVATION_20260411_v0 (Turn 15) generator against updated surface state

decision_tree.condition: At least one surface completed AND has computed outputs showing state change
decision_tree.expected_outcome: MATERIAL_CASCADE_CONFIRMED (if outputs show measurable downstream consequence)
decision_tree.next_layer: Document cascade consequence, promote findings to broader analysis

decision_tree.condition: All surfaces completed AND none show computed outputs or show completion with no state change
decision_tree.next_layer: Document authority-local result, confirm promotion remains bounded

decision_tree.condition: Mixed: some surfaces completed, others still pending
decision_tree.assessment: Partial recompute completion; insufficient for final ruling
decision_tree.next_layer: Continue monitoring until all surfaces reach terminal state

no_execution_until: At least one recompute surface moves beyond PENDING_RECOMPUTE state
monitoring_frequency: As-needed observation; no polling schedule required
layer_description: Monitoring protocol establishing observation posture and decision rule for when recompute outputs become available. No execution layers beneath this point until completion signal arrives. Clean wait-and-observe discipline.
